edits.name: Loa Bone Covenant
edits.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Input is the edit target, a complete painted fantasy HUD texture sheet. Keep every actual bone/clay/cord or porcelain/crystal/bronze piece of artwork EXACTLY, with its positions, colors, materials, geometry and component count unchanged. Clean its alpha matte: remove the spurious colored fringing, red/yellow/white haze and loose speckle clouds around the silhouettes and inside every empty window. Those are backdrop/matting contamination, not part of the objects. The background, all 32 button windows, map window, portrait circles, straight health/power/cast channels, curved resource channels and empty reminder rings must all be genuine transparent alpha-zero. Preserve opaque physical edges and tiny intended details. No white or brown background, no glow, no drop shadow, no checkerboard, no text, no crop. Sharp clean alpha-cutout edges with slight antialiasing only. Output the same complete square sheet.

edits.name: Black Ledger
edits.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image is the EDIT TARGET, a complete painted HUD asset sheet. Preserve ALL casings, component positions, colors, materials, open apertures, silhouettes and art scale EXACTLY. Change ONLY the central row of FIVE COMBO INDICATORS below the cast bar: replace its current mixed trinkets with five matching narrow silver STEEL DAGGER TIPS, each a painted solid knife point with a small black leather wrapped base. This row must consist of FIVE examples of ONE SPECIFIC ICON FAMILY, identical visual weight, consistent approximate size, coherent as five charge indicators in one HUD. Do not retain any other trinket families. All five must be solid actual painted sprites, not empty rings, with real transparent space around them. Keep the two empty buff reminder rings BELOW this row untouched and clearly separate. Keep the seven menu glyphs unchanged. Do not add any label or number. While preserving original art, remove stray colored edge-matte freckles/haze outside the objects and inside functional windows. No background, glow cloud, checkerboard or backdrop. Preserve original alpha transparency, truly transparent holes and broad gutters. Same painterly sculpted WoW UI art. All components fully inside canvas, no cropping. Output the entire corrected sheet at the original square framing.
